harnessReconciliation: Raw runs preserve their failures: transient registration network error, cached directory, missing wallet session, and obsolete challenge/202 expectations. The final creator claim actually finalized with HTTP 200. All seven payouts were independently reverified from finalized chain data, exact allocation, configured recipients and withdrawal receipts. Creator SOL fee locking is retired; ticker protection and token escrow are separate.
limitations: Devnet program and Mainnet candidate have different binaries; Devnet success does not prove candidate live execution.
Historical paired conversions and buybacks were reverified, not newly executed.
Creator payout replay, developer escrow maturity, holder/community end-user claims, graduation and all 14 Mainnet acceptance cases are not established by these runs.
No Mainnet custody process admitted or activated; no Mainnet transaction signed or submitted.

configuration.scope: Compared full resolved configurations; only release service image/revision and frontend identity differ. Other bind/config content compared by SHA256; secret references, infrastructure images, networks, volumes, policies and resource limits preserved.

browser.scope: Live public UI: startup, page search, destination focus, Help and viewport overflow. All non-read requests blocked; no wallet or transaction.

funding.scope: Rent and public balance only; excludes transaction fees, initialization, operating reserve and financial acceptance. No funding authorization.
